commit_title: Remove pre-filter UI/store and add runDataPipeline
commit_message: Delete PreFilterSideMenu and PreFilterStore and simplify data processing by introducing runDataPipeline in DataFrameLib. Components (PlotArea, TableArea, PlotAreaControlButtons) now call runDataPipeline or directly use Step_1_filter instead of the removed Step_0_pre_filter; imports were adjusted accordingly. The new runDataPipeline orchestrates filtering, grouping and ink-ratio reduction and returns processed traces (and filtered data) to be used when generating plot config and exporting HTML.
